Name: Vin's Manul
Author: ladycresovin
Description:
[b][color=#999999][size=5][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55349/55349-1794336155-1781545632.gif[/img][/i][/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#999999][size=5][i]T[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]h[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]e [/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]b[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]o[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]d[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]y [/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]i[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]s [/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]r[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]o[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]u[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]n[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]d[/i][/size][/color][color=#999999][size=5][i]...[/i][/size][/color][/b][color=#ffffff]

This mod replaces the vanilla cat texture with a Pallas' Cat, and optionally alters the meowing sound to be deeper and adds a new custom adoption scene![/color]

[color=#674ea7][size=6][i][b]F[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6][i][b]e[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][i][b]a[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][i][b]tu[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][i][b]r[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6][i][b]e[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6][i][b]s[/b][/i][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]A cute manul![/*]
[*]New, deeper meow sound (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn?gameId=1303]aedenthorn[/url]'s [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]Sound Tweaker[/url][/i].)[/*]
[*]A custom adoption scene[/*]
[*]Configuration options (can choose which of the five cats to replace, and can disable features like the meow sound or event)[/*]
[/list]To view the adoption scene, it has the same preconditions as the normal scene with Marnie, except it takes place in the Mountains. Visit there on the first sunny Wednesday or Friday morning after making a total of 1,000G to adopt the manul.

[i][b][color=#674ea7][size=6]In[/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]st[/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]alla[/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]ti[/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6]on[/size][/color][/b][/i]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure the latest versions of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/i] and [url=https://smapi.io/][i]SMAPI[/i] [/url]are installed and working.[/*]
[*](Optional; required for custom meow sounds) Ensure the latest version of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]Sound Tweaker[/url][/i] is installed and working.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Adding on pre–existing saves[/b]:
If adding to a pre–existing save, you must set the [font=Courier New]New Adoption Event[/font] setting to "[font=Courier New]false[/font]". Otherwise, you'll see duplicate scenes and it might give errors! Other than that, make sure you correctly set the [font=Courier New]Cat to Replace[/font] option to turn your friend into a manul.

[b]To uninstall:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Simply delete the [font=Courier New][CP] Vin's Manul[/font] folder from your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffffff][b]To configure[/b][/color]:
[list=1]
[*]Run the game at least once through SMAPI with the mod installed to generate the mod's [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file.[/*]
[*]Close the game, then navigate to your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder and open the newly generated [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file inside the [font=Courier New][CP] Vin's Manul[/font] folder using a text editor.[/*]
[*]Change values from "[font=Courier New]true[/font]" to "[font=Courier New]false[/font]" at your preferences. The "[font=Courier New]CatToReplace[/font]" option accepts any one of "[font=Courier New]OrangeTabby[/font]", "[font=Courier New]GreyTabby[/font]", "[font=Courier New]Yellow[/font]", "[font=Courier New]White[/font]", or "[font=Courier New]Black[/font]".[/*]
[*]Save, then open the game as usual.[/*]
[/list]You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/spacechase0?gameId=1303]spacechase0[/url]'s [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/i] to easily configure the mod in–game!

[color=#674ea7][size=6][b][i]Co[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b][i]mp[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b][i]atibi[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b][i]li[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6][b][i]ty[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Only works with [i]SMAPI[/i] 4.5.2 or later.[/*]
[*] Should be able to work in singleplayer, multiplayer, and split–screen. ([i]Note that in multiplayer, all players must have the same "[font=Courier New]CatToReplace[/font]" option in the config, else they might not be able to see the manul![/i])[/*]
[*]If you are using the new meow sound, it may conflict with mods that also edit this sound effect.[/*]
[*]If you are using the custom adoption event, it may conflict with mods that edit the Mountain map.[/*]
[/list][color=#674ea7][size=6][b][i]Tr[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b][i]an[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b][i]slat[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b][i]io[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6][b][i]ns[/i][/b][/size][/color]
This mod uses i18n and supports easy translations. Currently, only English is available, but if you would like to contribute a translation, feel free to get into contact with me so that I may add it to the mod itself, or provide a link to your translation so I may link it here!

[b][i][color=#674ea7][size=6]C[/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]r[/size][/color][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]edi[/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]t[/size][/color][color=#674ea7][size=6]s[/size][/color][/i][/b]
All textures were created by me using [i][url=https://aseprite.org/]Aesprite[/url][/i] v1.3.18.6. Custom meowing sounds were sourced from [url=https://freesound.org/people/itinerantmonk108/]itinerantmonk108[/url] on [i][url=https://freesound.org/people/itinerantmonk108/sounds/582745/]Freesound[/url][/i] and edited using [i][url=https://www.audacityteam.org/audacity-4/]Audacity 4[/url][/i].

Absolutely no AI or other generative programs were used in any part of the creation of this mod or its assets. Everything you see is hand–crafted by humans, for humans (or cats!) <3
